sample_unit: ChatGPT-summarized MRI reports (from 5 full reports), rated by 12 radiation oncologists

links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid grade level of full MRI reports versus ChatGPT plain-language summaries
links.effect: Median FK score fell from 9.6 for full MRI reports to 5.0 for summarized reports (p < 0.05).
links.quote: The median FK score for the full MRI reports and summarized reports was 9.6 vs. 5.0, (p < 0.05), respectively.

screen.reason: Evaluates feasibility, readability, and radiation oncologist satisfaction with ChatGPT-generated patient summaries of prostate cancer MRI reports.
